What is the maximum amount of the penalty applicable in Italy, on 1 February 2027, to a manufacturer infringing Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: On 1 February 2027, what is the highest penalty that Italy would impose on a manufacturer that violates Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?
